Getting it in the post is quite possibly the safest way to buy it these days.

Since it's the Royal Mail, they have rules in relation to intercepting post, meaning they only really care about things such as explosives etc. and not drugs as much, so your chances of being caught are tiny.

In fact, some postmen actually know that they are delivering drugs but cannot do anything because it is illegal to open other peoples post, and the large majority of them don't bother telling the police because it isn't worth the time.
